supported_scope: Terminal sandbox for agent shell commands on Linux (kernel namespaces) and macOS (sandbox-exec). Workspace and write_file paths read-write, read_file paths read-only, everything else inaccessible; no network by default except read_url domains.
unestablished_scope: CLI terminal sandbox on Windows (the CLI section lists Linux and macOS only)
Isolation of the agent's own file-edit tools, as distinct from shell commands
required_setup: enableTerminalSandbox defaults to false; enable it in settings.json or with --sandbox.
constraints: unsandboxed(...) allow rules and approved agent requests run commands outside the sandbox

evidence.quote: Antigravity CLI executes commands inside an OS-level isolation boundary
Sandboxed commands run without network access by default
